$comment: Front matter for Webex Canon rooms. Checked by scripts/validate_lessons.mjs. Level is a study band from 0 to 10, not a lock.

properties.key: string, '<track>/<room id>', must match a rooms/*.html file
properties.title: string, must equal the room h1
properties.outcomes: array of at least one phrase, each at least 8 characters
properties.sources: array of at least one id that exists in data/sources-catalog.json
properties.has_exercise: boolean, true when the room has a quiz or lab section
properties.last_verified: null or YYYY-MM-DD from the room citation ledger
